sources.entry: LocalRadio - LocalRadio is software for listening to "Software-Defined Radio" on your Mac and mobile devices.

summary.one_liner: LocalRadio is an experimental, GPL-2 licensed Mac app that plays software-defined radio (RTL-SDR) broadcasts and shares them to phones, tablets and other devices on a home network through a web interface.
summary.what_it_does: LocalRadio uses an inexpensive RTL-SDR USB device plugged into a Mac to receive radio, including local FM, free music, news, sports, weather, public safety and aviation scanner traffic, and other sources. Its web interface lets the radio be shared from the Mac to iPhones, iPads, Android devices and PCs on the local network, using only a mobile browser. Audio can also be sent to an Apple TV or other AirPlay-compatible devices. Recent versions add stereo listening for FM broadcasts and audio devices. Listening directly on the Mac needs no network connection. The README also notes a 2026 change: the project has been converted to a Swift app for Apple Silicon Macs under the new name AntennaHead.
use_cases: listen to FM radio on a Mac with an RTL-SDR dongle
stream radio to phones and tablets at home
play radio through AirPlay speakers or Apple TV
monitor public safety and aviation scanners
how_to_run: Plug an RTL-SDR USB device into the Mac
Download the latest pre-release alpha of the LocalRadio app from the link in the README
Launch LocalRadio on the Mac and tune to a station
On other devices on the same home network, open the mobile browser and connect to LocalRadio's web interface
notable: Web interface shares radio to phones, tablets, Android and PCs with no extra software
AirPlay output to Apple TV and compatible speakers
Stereo FM listening option in recent versions
README announces conversion to Swift app for Apple Silicon Macs, renamed AntennaHead
caveats: Experimental pre-release software with no independent testing yet, per README
Not recommended for public IP addresses or security testing; intended for private LAN use
Requires an RTL-SDR device for reception
